articles.title: India’s finance minister says market liquidity makes it easier for investors to exit
articles.description: Sitharaman identified fuel, fertilizer and access to capital as risks for India’s economy in 2027.

articles.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs shed $549M as October ETH outflows near $1B
articles.description: US spot Ether ETFs recorded around $955 million in October net outflows so far, while Bitcoin funds extended their weekly withdrawal streak to two weeks.

articles.title: China's CXMT shares fall nearly 8% as investors look past chipmaker's profit turnaround
articles.description: CXMT shares fell nearly 8% on Monday after the company released its earnings forecast for the first nine months of 2026.

articles.title: Bitcoin whale moves $34 million in BTC it got in 2013 when coins traded at $131
articles.description: A bitcoin wallet dormant since 2013 moved 411 BTC, now worth about $34 million. It is one of several long-dormant wallets to wake up recently.

articles.title: OpenAI bugging suspect WhatsApp'ed Saudi royal days before arrest, feds reveal
articles.description: Saudi national Abdulrahman Alfozan is accused of planting a recording device in an executive conference room at OpenAI headquarters in San Francisco.

articles.title: Zoom adds ‘proof of human’ badges to show you’re not a deepfake
articles.description: Sam Altman-backed World has rolled out biometric verification badges for Zoom enterprise users, aiming to combat AI deepfake impersonation and fraud.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi rejects criticism around weak yen and high interest rates
articles.description: The prime minister denied that her policies were responsible for the yen’s weakness or rising JGB yields.

articles.title: Zcash developers plan a fix to keep ZEC swaps private from future quantum computers
articles.description: The team behind Zakura wants every swap through NEAR Intents to get its own key, so a refund address left on NEAR’s public chain can’t expose a user’s wider payment history.

articles.title: South Korea to meet crypto exchanges amid calls for tax delay
articles.description: Finance officials are reportedly set to meet major crypto exchanges on Tuesday, days after a lawmaker introduced legislation that could push the tax’s start date back two years.

articles.title: XRP Ledger is set to fix its lending code before anyone can use it
articles.description: Validators have a bug-fix patch on course to go live Friday. The lending system it partly repairs is still 10 votes short of approval.

articles.title: China's third-quarter economic growth quickens to 4.5% as exports surge, beating estimates
articles.description: China's economic growth accelerated in the third quarter, as foreign demand for the country's technological goods largely offset sluggish consumer demand.

articles.title: Putin reportedly suggests summit with Trump and Xi to decide fate of Ukraine
articles.description: The report comes amid mounting tensions between Ukraine and the United States, its largest military backer.

articles.title: Bitcoin, Korea’s Kospi and Nasdaq futures rally as China GDP beats estimates
articles.description: Bitcoin, Nasdaq futures and Asian stocks rally as stronger-than-expected China GDP and falling oil prices lift risk appetite.

articles.title: France hit by worst unrest in years as attempts to rein in government spending meet citizen ire
articles.description: France’s worst unrest in years saw thousands arrested, prompting President Macron to vow an “uncompromising” response ahead of a critical budget vote.

articles.title: Indonesian stocks plunge to six-year low as MSCI downgrade fears mount
articles.description: Indonesia's benchmark stock index plunged to its lowest level in six years.

articles.title: Deutsche Bank targets Asia crypto custody expansion in 2027 as German launch nears
articles.description: The service will initially support bitcoin, ether and the stablecoins USDC, EURC and EURAU, with the bank managing clients’ wallets and private keys.

articles.title: Qubic freezes chain after attacker drains 1.4K wallets with weak seeds
articles.description: Qubic says 87.1% of the stolen funds remain onchain and the rest were frozen at crypto exchange MEXC, as network validators prepare to vote on a recovery plan.

articles.title: SEC tokenized stock framework faces issuer pushback as Broadcom, Verizon object to OKX-ICE listing
articles.description: Eight more companies objected to trading on the planned OKX-ICE venue, while Nasdaq has separately said it would opt out under the SEC’s framework.

articles.title: Richard Heart caught ‘off-guard,’ QDay gets even closer: Hodler’s Digest
articles.description: HEX founder Richard Heart detained in early morning raid in Istanbul, Starknet plunges almost 50% as it votes to become an L1, and Bitwise says all signs point to Crypto Spring.
